_readme: Single source of truth for all website text. Edit the values here (not the keys).
{placeholders} such as {brand}, {city}, {year}, {name}, {ref} are filled in automatically - keep them where you want the value to appear.
Sections 'settings', 'packages_data', 'faqs_data', 'eventCards_data' and 'gallerySamples_data' are only the FIRST-RUN defaults that get saved to the database.
After the first run, edit those from Admin -> Website Content (changing them here will not overwrite what is already in the database).
Everything else (nav, hero, experience, form labels, footer...) is read live from this file - just save and rebuild/refresh.

faqs_data.question: What events can PAL be booked for?
faqs_data.answer: Weddings, sangeet, mehendi, birthdays, corporate events, college festivals, Navratri and festive events, private parties and brand activations. If you are planning something different, just ask.

faqs_data.question: How long does the photobooth service last?
faqs_data.answer: Our standard packages are for 4 hours of photobooth service. Setup happens before your event start time.

faqs_data.question: Are the prints unlimited?
faqs_data.answer: Yes — all three packages include unlimited photo prints during the booked duration.

faqs_data.question: Can the photo strips be customized?
faqs_data.answer: Absolutely. Every package includes PAL and event branding on the prints. PLUS and PREMIUM include customized layouts and photo designs made for your event.

faqs_data.question: Do you provide props?
faqs_data.answer: PLUS and PREMIUM packages include premium props. Tell us your theme and we will help you plan the fun.

faqs_data.question: Is an attendant available?
faqs_data.answer: Yes. An on-site PAL attendant is included in every package to run the booth and help your guests.

faqs_data.question: How far does PAL travel?
faqs_data.answer: We are based in Vadodara and cover events across Gujarat. For outstation events, travel charges may apply — share your location and we will confirm.

faqs_data.question: How do I book?
faqs_data.answer: Send us an inquiry using the form on this page or message us on WhatsApp. We will discuss your requirements, confirm your package and lock your date with an advance.

faqs_data.question: Can I book PAL for more than four hours?
faqs_data.answer: Yes. Additional hours and custom requirements can be discussed — get in touch and we will put together a quote.
